item.title: Phil Labonte: Korn’s Impact on Deathcore Goes Beyond Nu-Metal
item.description: When a band ends up becoming so influential that people start crediting them for launching a whole subgenre, it’s something to take note of. But when a group gets blamed for a genre they don’t even directly belong to?
